description: This file is a shell script used for testing a Git extension or feature related to 'compatObjectFormat', which involves setting up multiple Git repositories with different object formats (sha1 and sha256), creating various objects like commits, trees, tags, and signed objects, and verifying their consistency and transformations across formats. The script includes setup, object creation, signing, tagging, and extensive comparison functions to ensure the 'compatObjectFormat' functionality operates correctly across different hashing algorithms.

methods.name: compat_hash
methods.description: Switches between sha1 and sha256 hash algorithms.

methods.name: hello_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a 'hello' object based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: tree_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a 'tree' object based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a 'commit' object based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: commit2_oid
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID for a second 'commit' object based on the hash algorithm.

methods.name: del_sigcommit
methods.description: Deletes the GPG signature from a commit, based on the specified hash type.

methods.name: del_sigtag
methods.description: Deletes signatures from tags, based on storage and delete parameters.

methods.name: compare_oids
methods.description: Runs a series of git object inspections and comparisons to verify consistency of objects across different hash formats.
